cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Agree to the Exact Words
cards.instruction: Agree to the exact wording, then use later callbacks to narrow what those words can obligate you to do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I agreed to watch your dog today. I've put his bowl away like you did, so we're finishing up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I put it away before his medicine, not at bedtime. My train won't get in until after midnight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, clearing for the next stage. Today still ends at midnight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My brother can collect him at eleven, but he'd have to bring him back here while he goes to the station for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Eleven is today; bringing him back isn't in our sentence. Ask your brother to take him to the station too.

reason: Replace assumed unaccompanied taxi transport with an explicitly available brother, so B4 supplies the helper whose proposed return A narrows through the exact promise.
